From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Rajiv / Nina — answering both points below and including references to the deliverables we attached. See the quoted lines from your earlier message for context.

> "Can you confirm the residency for EdgeScale (country) and whether any processing happens in EU data centers?"

- EdgeScale: Purpose = telemetry & anonymized runtime metrics only. Primary residency: Ireland (IE). We use EdgeScale-managed collectors; the telemetry pipeline that receives anonymized metrics is hosted in EdgeScale EU region (Dublin). EdgeScale does NOT have access to customer plaintext keys or KV caches. They receive only aggregated application-level metrics (no message payloads).

> "For the KMS pathing: if we go with Redwood Private (VPC), can Medicore provide its own KMS (BYOK)? Or is the key management always Redwood-hosted for any Private option?"

- KMS options: For Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem bundle) customers may provision their own KMS (BYOK) — Redwood provides configuration guides and an HSM/KMS integration checklist. For hosted-API customers, Redwood uses our managed KMS but supports BYOK for Dedicated accounts via a key-escrow flow. Ben attached a short KMS pathing summary describing where customer-managed keys are supported (redwood_kms_pathing_summary.txt).

Deliverables attached to this message:
- redwood_subprocessors_aug2026.csv (CSV export) — already attached in the prior message; reattached for convenience.
- redwood_sig3_mapping_aug2026.pdf — short mapping matrix (SIG3/CAIQ rows vs hosted/dedicated/private columns) with references to controls that map to customer responsibilities.
- redwood_kms_pathing_summary.txt — one-page summary for procurement and architecture teams.

If it helps, we can set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the mapping and any redaction questions with Laura on the line. Let me know preferred time windows (I have 10:00–12:00 and 15:00–16:30 PDT).

Best regards,
Priyom Das
